messages:
tia.sales: Passing to CS + eng  HelionGov (gov agency) started a trial today. Renewal window ~60d. They require SSO (SAML), encrypted-at-rest KMS, and stable audit webhooks. Priya is POC (priya@helion.gov). Initial issues: SAML claim for 'gov_id' missing, webhook POSTs intermittently 500, and they asked for Private deployment pricing.

noah.cs: Ill take CS owner. Success criteria: SSO (email + gov_id), webhooks <1% errors, audit delivery latency <250ms P95. Can sales share the repro and logs?

tia.sales: Logs + sample payload uploaded to ticket #22011. Error snippet: `{"error":"MsgSizeExceeded"}`. Priya said they can compress if needed but prefer not to change client.

lee.support: Picked up #22011. Triage: our edge proxy rejects payloads >1MB. Short-term ask: request gzip or chunking. Long-term: bump limit or support streaming. I attached repro curl and raw sample.

mara.eng: cc @lee.support @noah.cs  I can scope a fix: config bump (24h) or stream implementation (48-72h). Need exact repro and stack traces. If they need Private for compliance, note deployment timeline ~3-4w.

sophie.finance: Ill draft Private vs Dedicated cost delta (ballpark) and post by EOD tomorrow.

provision-bot: Ticket #22011 created by lee.support. SLA: 24h response requested.

noah.cs: Action owners: CS=@noah.cs, Support=@lee.support, Eng=@mara.eng, Sales=@tia.sales, Finance=@sophie.finance. Next check-in tomorrow 10:00 PT. Ill update when repro confirmed.
